description.value: Boardwalk Fries Burgers Shakes is a Canadian fast-casual chain founded in 1981, serving fresh made-to-order burgers, hand-cut boardwalk-style fries, and creamy milkshakes. The Abbotsford location sits along Fraser Highway, a main east-west cycling corridor through the Fraser Valley. The menu includes veggie burgers and poutine alongside classic beef burgers and chicken dishes.
